mapper.select:
select tpd.TRADE_ID as id ,tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpda.trade_id = tpd.trade_id WHERE tpd.TRADE_STATUS != '03' AND tpd.is_cancel != 'Y' and tpd.finprod_type in ('F11','F12','F13')
AND tpd.trade_id like '%' || #{search} || '%'
GROUP BY tpd.TRADE_ID,tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID

select mvf.FINPROD_ID2 finprodId2, /* 交易编号 - 金融产品代码（市场代码） */ tpd.finprod_type foreignexChangeType, /* 外汇类型 */ TO_CHAR(mvf.VAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') valDate, /* 估值日期 */ mvf.VALUATION valuation, /* 估值 - 每日估值 */ mvf.CCY ccy, /* 币种 */ mvf.VALMODEL_ID valmodelId, /* 估值模型 */ mvf.DATASOURCE_TYPE datasourceType, /* 估值来源 - 数据来源 */ mvf.INPUT_TYPE inputType /* 维护方式 - 录入方式，接口、手工等 */ ,tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId from MST_VAL_FX mvf left join trd_product_deal tpd on tpd.trade_id = mvf.finprod_id2 and tpd.finprod_type in ('F11','F12','F13') LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpda.trade_id = tpd.trade_id
AND FINPROD_ID2 like '%' || #{finprodId2} || '%'
and tpd.finprod_type in
#{item}
and VAL_DATE >= to_date(#{valDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and VAL_DATE <= to_date(#{valDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND DATASOURCE_TYPE in
#{item}
select TRADE_ID from trd_product_deal where FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F11','F12','F13') and IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TRADE_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select TRADE_ID from trd_product_deal where FINPROD_TYPE2 = decode(#{finProdType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'即期','F11','远期','F12','掉期','F13') and IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TRADE_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT item_code ccy FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST SDL WHERE SDL.dict_code = 'CCY' AND SUBSTR(item_value, 0, decode(INSTR(item_value,'('),0,INSTR(item_value,'（'),INSTR(item_value,'('))-1) = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
